name: Fujita Tetsuharu
source: Fujita is a skilled robotics mechanic who runs the Robot Clinic, a shop selling robot components which [url=/c86163]Misaki[/url] and later [url=/c36543]Akiho[/url] often visit for parts. Despite his grumpy personality, he's known to be helpful. He's the grandfather of [url=/c36547]Junna[/url].
